The '''All-Nationalist Nogoyev Party''' was the main political movement behind Nogoyev's sovereignty declaration and the restoration of the Tsarist system. It grew during the late 1940s from resentment against Zhensanovian centralization, economic disparity, and cultural suppression.

The source describes it as a populist and nationalist movement that called for democratic reforms, sovereignty, and restoration of the Tsar.

== Rise ==

The party exploited the [[Union of Zhensanov]]'s distraction during the final years of the [[Avant Great War]]. While Zhensanov supported the [[United Alignment of Nations]], Nogoyevian organizers built clandestine networks, distributed propaganda, coordinated protests, and prepared a shadow government.

The movement gained support among civilians and among Nogoyevian elements inside the Union military.

== Role In The War ==

In early 1949, party leaders declared Nogoyevian sovereignty and called for Tsarist restoration. Zhensanov rejected the declaration, beginning the [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]].

The party's wartime role after the declaration needs more detail, especially its relationship to military commanders, militias, and the later [[Tsardom of Nogoyev]].
